basic_details.job_title: NAM Thrissur Ayurvedic Therapist Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ayurvedic therapist (female): Passed a 5-year Ayurvedic Therapist course (DAME) from Kerala Government, OR passed a 1-year Ayurvedic Therapist course from NARIP. Candidates must have a registration that is not barred under Kerala Government within one year.

vacancy_details.details: The notification does not specify the exact total number of vacancies; vacancies are noted as openings to be filled on a contract basis under the National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur district.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview
and if more than 20 candidates turn up
a written examination will be conducted as part of the selection procedure.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria regarding age and qualifications before attending.
Prepare original certificates and self-attested copies of certificates proving educational qualification, age, address, and experience.
Report for the walk-in interview on 15 October 2026 at 10:30 AM.
Attend the interview at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager Office, Thrissur.
Participate in the written test if the candidate count exceeds 20.
important_instructions: Applicants must be female candidates. Candidates must bring original certificates along with self-attested copies of certificates proving qualification, age, and address to the interview venue. If candidates currently work at Ramavarma District Ayurveda Hospital, they must produce certified copies of certificates. If more than 20 candidates attend, a written examination will be held prior to the interview. Employment is purely on a contract basis under the National AYUSH Mission. For additional information, candidates can contact telephone number 0487 - 2939190.

faq.question: Q1. What is NAM Thrissur Ayurvedic Therapist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the National AYUSH Mission Thrissur to hire Ayurvedic Therapists on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NAM Thrissur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026 at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Ayurvedic Therapist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a 5-year Ayurvedic Therapist course (DAME) from the Kerala Government not barred within one year, or a 1-year Ayurvedic Therapist course from NARIP.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years.
